summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. Compaction rewrites in Iceberg fail when concurrent deletion vectors are added to source files, causing costly retries. Options include keeping the meeting at 15:00 UTC year‑round or pinning it to 8 AM US Pacific time, with contributors from the US, Europe, and Asia weighing in on the impact of each choice. The session concluded with action items for developers to prepare for the next major update and to ensure a smooth transition to the stable release.
